method: ordered end-cap boundary loop; native (x, y, z) = (X, -Z, Y)
notes: Measured approximation of an approved display mesh. Not recovered manufacturing geometry. Contact regions are native SubShapeBinder runs of the profile sketch extruded along X, so they follow profile dimension edits. Residual mounting-bore cap patches in the reference are not reproduced.

omittedFeatures.evidence: Tools/HangboardModels/mounting_bore_repairs.json records six 13 mm bores for this board at x = +/-75 mm and +/-225 mm (y = 14 mm) and x = +/-225 mm (y = 96 mm). The pre-migration asset no longer has the bores but still carries six flat circular cap patches at those positions; measured boundary loops confirm the locations. The migrated asset has a continuous surface there. Two-way sampled deviation from the reference is 0.21 mm worst case, so the patches are essentially flush and no material feature is omitted.
omittedFeatures.correction: An earlier revision of this record described these as twelve 3.44 mm circular mounting passages. That was wrong: they are six flush cap patches, and the measured deviation bound shows nothing is omitted.
omittedFeatures.scope: Display asset only; this is not a claim about the physical product.
